KinematicObservation.description:
What the user reported about how the set moved (v0, plan §6.3).

This records the user's own words, never a form diagnosis made by the system.
KinematicObservation.title: KinematicObservation

Load.description: A load as reported by the user, in the user's unit (conversion to kg happens in ingest).

value.description: Load magnitude; 0 is allowed for bodyweight-only sets. Ints are accepted (80 -> 80.0).
value.title: Value

Load.title: Load

Outcome.description:
Outcome of the set described in a note or message. The field is never null.

``completed``: no failure or partial completion is reported, which includes notes that do not mention the
outcome at all. ``partial``: fewer reps than planned were completed. ``failed``: the attempted rep or set was not
completed. Proposed in the #69 review, and the Fi1 guideline should carry the same definition.
Outcome.title: Outcome

TriageLevel.description:
Safety triage level of a note or message (plan §5.3).

``green``: no symptoms. ``yellow``: mild discomfort, stiffness, persistent soreness.
``red``: sharp pain, swelling, dizziness, chest pain. Ordered by severity: green < yellow < red.
TriageLevel.title: TriageLevel

description:
Structured extraction of one note or free-text message (plan §6.3).

All seven keys are required. ``load``, ``reps`` and ``rpe`` are ``null`` when not reported: never omitted and
never 0 by default. Numbers are strict, so booleans, numeric strings and inf/NaN are rejected. Ints are accepted
for float fields (8 -> 8.0).

Multi-exercise messages (proposed in the #69 review; final wording in the Fi1 guideline): if a symptom is
reported, ``exercise_id`` and the set fields describe the exercise linked to the most severe symptom. With no
symptom, or a tie, they describe the first exercise that has set data. If that cannot be resolved, use
``unknown``. ``triage_level`` is always the maximum over the whole message.

exercise_id.description: free-exercise-db id, or 'unknown' when the exercise cannot be resolved.
exercise_id.title: Exercise Id

load.description: Reported load, or null when no load is stated.

reps.description: Explicit repetition count, or null when not stated.
reps.title: Reps

rpe.description: Explicit RPE (0-10), or null when not stated.
rpe.title: Rpe
